arabic text: JAB KHUDA KO PUKARA ALI AAGAYE
english translation text: WHEN WE CALLED UPON GOD, ALI WAS SENT TO HELP US
WHEN ALI CAME TO US, OUR LIVES CAME
LIFE, ATTACHMENT (TO THEIR LOVE), LIGHT CAME

arabic text: MAWT INKE MUHIBON KO AATI NAHI
english translation text: DEATH CANNOT COME TO HIS LOVERS (LOVERS AREN'T AFRAID OF DEATH)

arabic text: AA BHI JAAYE TO PHIR BACHKE JAATI NAHI
english translation text: AND IF IT DOES COME, IT CANNOT ESCAPE

arabic text: MAUT KA KYA KHATAR\nMAWT SE KYA HAZAR
english translation text: BUT WHAT DANGER IS THERE FROM DEATH? WHY SHOULD WE FEAR IT

arabic text: ISSE BACHNA BHI KYA AAGAYI AAGAYI
english translation text: WHY TRY ESCAPE IT, IT IS HERE THEN IT IS HERE

arabic text: GHUSLE MAYYIT NA KEHNA MERE GHUSL KO\nUJLE MALBOOS KO MAT KAFAN NAAM DO
english translation text: DO NOT CALL MY FINAL GHUSL THE GHUSL OF MAYYIT\nDON'T CALL THE WRAPPED CLOTH A KAFAN

arabic text: ME CHALA HOON ALI SE MULAQAT KO\nJISKI THI ARZOO WOH GHARI AGAYI
english translation text: I AM GOING TO MEET ALI\nTHE MOMENT I HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR HAS FINALLY ARRIVED

arabic text: MASLAKE ISHQ MEIN MAANGA AIB HAI
english translation text: IN THE MATTERS OF LOVE, TO ASK IS NOT A GOOD THING

arabic text: ME BHI KHAMOSH HOON\nWOH BHI KHAMOSH HAI
english translation text: I AM SILENT, HE IS SILENT

arabic text: UN KO SAB HAI KHABAR IS LIYE CHUP HOON MEIN\nKYA HUWA AANKH ME GAR NAMI AAGAYI
english translation text: HE KNOWS EVERYTHING THAT IS WHY I AM SILENT\nSO WHAT IF MY EYES ARE SOFTENED\n(WITH TEARS)

arabic text: KHUMS DENA MUWADAT KI EK SHART HAI
english translation text: TO GIVE IS A CONDITION OF LOVE

arabic text: AUR NA DENA BHI MISLE FADAK HAI GUNAH
english translation text: AND NOT TO GIVE IS A GUNAH, SIMILAR TO THE WAY THE INCIDENT OF FADAK WAS

arabic text: HAQ KE SADAT O ZAHRA KE MAKROOZ SE\nJAB TABARRA SUNA TO HASEEN AAGAYI
english translation text: FROM THE RIGHTFUL LINEAGE OF ZAHRA\nWHEN WE HEARD TABARRA, OUR FACES LIT UP

arabic text: ISHQ JAB TAK NA SHER HOTA NAHIN\nMUJHME KAB AHLIYAT THI TERI MADHA KI
english translation text: UNTIL THERE IS LOVE, THERE WILL BE NO POETRY\nWHERE DID I HAVE THE ABILITY TO PRAISE YOU

arabic text: MERE MOLA ME QURBAN TERE ISHQ KE\nSIBTE JAFAR KO BHI SHAYRI AAGAYI
english translation text: ‘SIBT E JAFAR' ALSO LEARNT POETRY\nOH MASTER, MAY I BE SACRIFICED IN YOUR LOVE
